selection_basis: classification train/validation only; documentary scores not used

tsac.selection: all manifest v2 test rows without filtering

madar.selection: all manifest v2 test rows without filtering

tsac.instruction: Classe cet avis tunisien fourni en chaîne JSON. Réponds par NEG (négatif) ou POS (positif).

madar.instruction: Classe ce texte fourni en chaîne JSON. Réponds par MSA (arabe standard moderne), TN (arabe tunisien) ou EG (arabe égyptien).

metrics.invalid_policy: count as classification errors and retain INVALID column
metrics.stochastic_summary: mean and sample standard deviation over 13/42/2026

inference.qwen_overflow_policy: INVALID with prompt_too_long reason, included in scores

bootstrap.statistic: difference of mean macro_f1 over seeds, paired with fixed reference
bootstrap.primary_contrast: Qwen LoRA minus base in each prompt condition
secondary_contrasts: confirmed CAMeLBERT minus raw character TF-IDF

resource_protocol.apple_memory_policy: report CPU RSS and MPS snapshots separately
